generatedWorkflowSource:
name: Build private WebCodecs VP9 encoder without Docker
on:
  workflow_dispatch:
permissions:
  contents: read
concurrency:
  group: private-webcodecs-vp9-source
  cancel-in-progress: false
jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 30
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262
      - uses: actions/setup-node@49933ea5288caeca8642d1e84afbd3f7d6820020
        with:
          node-version: 24.7.0
      - name: Own all runtime scratch
        run: node scripts/ci-owned-runtime.mjs prepare
      - name: Check bounded JS bridge
        run: node --test --test-reporter=tap tests/webcodecs-vp9-bridge.test.mjs tests/webcodecs-vp9-source.test.mjs
      - name: Install build prerequisites
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends ca-certificates curl make patch pkg-config xz-utils
      - name: Install pinned SDK locally without Docker
        shell: bash
        run: |
          test ! -e work/webcodecs-vp9-emsdk
          git clone --filter=blob:none --no-checkout https://github.com/emscripten-core/emsdk.git work/webcodecs-vp9-emsdk
          git -C work/webcodecs-vp9-emsdk checkout 224ec5f9f2f72f09f9ce0e26d66bae7dbd8b692f
          test "$(git -C work/webcodecs-vp9-emsdk rev-parse HEAD)" = 224ec5f9f2f72f09f9ce0e26d66bae7dbd8b692f
          work/webcodecs-vp9-emsdk/emsdk install 6.0.4
          work/webcodecs-vp9-emsdk/emsdk activate 6.0.4
      - name: Compile real FFmpeg encoder plug-in and verify static native contract
        shell: bash
        run: |
          source work/webcodecs-vp9-emsdk/emsdk_env.sh
          export PATH="$(dirname "$EMSDK_NODE"):$PATH"
          bash media/ffmpeg/build-webcodecs-vp9.sh
      - name: Retain reusable private tools and compact source proofs only
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02
        with:
          name: private-webcodecs-vp9-${{ github.run_id }}
          path: work/webcodecs-vp9-output/
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 1
      - name: Remove disposable owned build and SDK data
        if: always()
        shell: bash
        run: |
          for task_path in "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/work/webcodecs-vp9-emsdk" "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/work/webcodecs-vp9-build" "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/work/webcodecs-vp9-output"; do
            case "$task_path" in
              "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/work/webcodecs-vp9-emsdk"|"$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/work/webcodecs-vp9-build"|"$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/work/webcodecs-vp9-output") ;;
              *) exit 2 ;;
            esac
            ! test -L "$task_path"
            rm -rf -- "$task_path"
          done
      - name: Remove owned runtime scratch
        if: always()
        env:
          NODE_DISABLE_COMPILE_CACHE: 1
        run: node scripts/ci-owned-runtime.mjs cleanup
